challenge.method: Tested whether SPDX’s ac-archive SourceForge link pointed to a better identity than the cited GNU autoconf-2.59.tar.gz. Compared the actual grantor, object and modification proviso in the acquired texts and followed the tag object’s target field.
challenge.results: The SPDX text names the FSF, Autoconf’s own source and the original non-data restriction. AX_PTHREAD instead names the macro owner and output produced when processing the macro. The historical file directly witnesses the SPDX text despite lacking the SPDX identifier.

limitations: The comparison allows for comment prefixes, spacing and wrapping. It establishes documentary correspondence without a byte-equality or template-match finding. SPDX’s source links are leads with shared textual lineage.
